# axm version

Manage extension manifest versions.

## When to use

Use this when preparing a local extension for publishing with a semantic version change.

## Usage

```bash
axm version [flags] <handle> <bump> [<version>]
```

## Arguments

| Name      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                               |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `handle`  | string | Yes      | Fully-qualified extension handle (@owner/<commands\|skills\|subagents\|mcps\|packs>/name) |
| `bump`    | string | Yes      | Version bump rule or set                                                                  |
| `version` | string | No       | Exact semver version for set                                                              |

## Flags

| Name        | Type    | Required | Description                    |
| ----------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--preview` | boolean | No       | Print the bump without writing |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Bump a command's patch version**

```bash
axm version @acme/commands/my-cmd patch
```

**Bump a skill's minor version**

```bash
axm version @acme/skills/code-review minor
```

**Bump a subagent's patch version**

```bash
axm version @acme/subagents/researcher patch
```

**Bump an MCP server's minor version**

```bash
axm version @acme/mcps/my-server minor
```

**Set an exact pack version**

```bash
axm version @acme/packs/frontend-tools set 1.2.3
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

- writesFiles
